meta.title: How it works | Keepsite Media
meta.description: One form, one call, one round of revisions. Here's exactly what building a site with Keepsite looks like, and what we need from you.

heading: How it works
lead: You've already made the decision to hand this off. From here it's five steps, and most of them are ours.

steps.title: Tell us about your business.
steps.body: One questionnaire covers it. We ask for everything we need in one pass, so you're not answering questions in dribs and drabs for three weeks.

steps.title: We plan the site.
steps.body: Which pages you need, how they connect, and what each one is there to do. On Search and Search Plus, keyword research comes first and shapes the plan.

steps.title: We build it.
steps.body: Design, copy, setup, and testing all happen on our side. You don't have to watch.

steps.title: One round of changes, then we launch.
steps.body: You look at the finished site and send your feedback in one go. We make the changes, run the final checks, and put it live.

steps.title: We keep it working.
steps.body: Hosting, maintenance, monitoring, and the annual recap. On Search and Search Plus, the articles keep going out too.

needFromYou.heading: What we need from you
items: Accurate information about your business: what you do, where, for whom, your hours, and anything a customer would ask.
Your photos and logo, if you have them.
One call, on Search and Search Plus, so we get your tone right.
A reply when a scheduled article needs a correction, or when something about the business changes.

wontHaveTo.heading: What you won't have to do
items: No decisions about hosting, plugins, or platforms.

closing.heading: Keep your business moving.
closing.sub: We'll take care of the website.
